name: coming-soon-state
title: Coming soon state
description: A placeholder for a feature that is not ready: what it will do, roughly when, and a button to be told when it launches.
docs: title gets the Soon badge, description says what the feature will do and expected completes "Planned for …". onNotify returns the promise of the sign-up: a rejection shows its message and the button comes back; success turns the button into "We will email you" (which takes the focus; after a rejection the button gets it back), remembered in localStorage under storageKey (default one per title). notified shows that state at once for people your server already knows. There is no countdown and no urgency. icon replaces the sparkle in the tile.
